Context: 20. Pension through Public Sector Banks / Post Office Savings Bank

11. Arrears of pension on the death of the pensioner.Pension is payable for the day of death of the pensioner. The Bank/ P.O. will, on receipt of the death certificate of the pensioner, verify his account and recover overpayment, if any, made. Arrears of pension due will be disbursed to the nominee,
